phases.name: Phase 1 - Deceptive Green & Hype
phases.description: Tech stocks gain modest positive momentum. Margin borrowing power looks very attractive.
news: Analyst upgrade on AI chip suppliers.
Retail margin loan volumes reach new monthly record.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Fundamental Shift & Building Confidence
phases.description: Earnings outperform expectations. Leveraged traders experience rapid equity expansion.
news: Online retail communities advocate 3x and 4x leverage.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Market Euphoria & Peak Leverage
phases.description: Extreme retail FOMO. Maximum buying power utilized across CFD and margin accounts.
news: Property price targets appear within reach for leveraged traders.

phases.name: Phase 4 - Minor Correction & Complacency
phases.description: A sharp 8-12% pullback occurs. Inexperienced investors dismiss it as a healthy dip.
news: Retail investors buy the dip aggressively on margin.

phases.name: Phase 5 - Crisis Begins & Bull Traps
phases.description: Early morning bounce turns into afternoon dumping. Margin health begins flashing warning alerts.
news: Regulators issue margin warning on tech conglomerates.

phases.name: Phase 6 - Margin Cascade & Forced Liquidation
phases.description: Systemic crash. Broker liquidation waves trigger limit-down cascades across holdings.
news: Unprecedented forced sales trigger account wipeouts.
